## Rendered output

- [ ] Not applicable; rendered output is unchanged.
- [ ] Canvas, SVG, PNG, and PDF remain aligned.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] The change is one coherent conceptual change.
- [ ] Earlier programs and caller-owned inputs remain immutable.
- [ ] Source, tests, declarations, current contracts, public docs, generated references, and examples are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] Public API, persisted state, renderer-boundary, or package-boundary decisions were agreed before implementation.
- [ ] I reviewed and understand every submitted change, including AI-assisted changes.
- [ ] I removed secrets, private data, generated caches, and unrelated edits.
